svg.aria-label: The loop one institute ran once becomes a tool any laboratory can run and keep
svg.text: The loop one institute ran once becomes a tool any laboratory can run and keep

g.text: A. What scBaseCount showed
An agent finds and annotates SRA experiments;
a fixed pipeline reprocesses them uniformly:
502 million cells, 27 organisms, one assay.
Built once by one institute on a cloud platform,
and offered as a blueprint rather than a tool.
B. What a laboratory needs
Every public dataset on its tissue, organism
or perturbation, processed with its own tools.
Today: a search, a spreadsheet, a fetcher,
a workflow manager, a cluster account, and
a person who keeps it all alive by hand.
C. DataBaseAgent
One binary on a laptop; nothing to deploy.
Free-text criteria; any assay; any shell steps.
Agents advise with verified verbatim evidence;
a person decides at three gates.
Agents run only when asked; jobs run on the
laboratory's own server and outlive the laptop.
Locked versions, manifests and checksums keep
the repository maintainable after it is built.
Design contribution; usability not yet evaluated.
